headline: Micron and chip stocks slip on election results
detail: Election outcomes are impacting data-center optimism, causing chip stocks like Micron to fall. This directly affects your concentrated tech and chip holdings, especially leveraged ones like SOXL and MU.
rec: Consider trimming MU given the sector weakness and its current PnL of -47.06%.

headline: CVS to split off drugstore business
detail: CVS is breaking up its healthcare giant, causing its shares to fall. While not directly tech, major sector shifts can sometimes create broader market volatility that impacts all stocks.
rec: This headline is not directly relevant to your tech-heavy portfolio, so no action is recommended.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield little changed
detail: The steady yield suggests no immediate pressure from interest rates. This is generally neutral for growth stocks, but your leveraged positions are sensitive to any shifts.
rec: No specific action is warranted by this headline alone, but monitor yields for any changes.
